regions.merged_text: Yesterday he wired from Seattle that our Brother Patrick is not well and just now ( 11 a.m. ) a wire from Minneapolis from Msgr. says he hopes to see Pat by Friday a.m. in Seattle. I sent Br. Patrick an air special yesterday after Owen's wire.
